Maya: Heads-up — since ~02:15 UTC we've seen a short burst of ECC/Xid spikes across ~12 cards in us-west-2. DCGM exporter shows repeated sample spikes (one-minute granularity) causing Prom rule flapping.
Liam: Which alert fired exactly? Prom rule name?
Maya: gpu_card_ecc_rate_high (expr: increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]) / increase(dcgm_samples_total[5m]) > 0.02) with for: 2m. It keeps re-firing because samples drop to 1-2 then jump, so ratio oscillates.
Jordan: Right — it's a sampling-rate artifact. Two quick mitigations: 1) stabilize sample denominator with a recording rule that windows/decays, 2) lower exporter scrape/sample rate for affected cards temporarily.
Rachel: Strong +1 on avoiding auto-drains for single spikes. We had a bad drain in prod last year. Need a weighted-streak detector (severity over time) instead of instant threshold.
Maya: Proposed recording rule snippet:
```
record: dcgm_ecc_windowed_rate
expr: (sum_over_time(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[10m]) + 0.5 * sum_over_time(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[30m])) / (max(1, sum_over_time(dcgm_samples_total[10m])))
```
Then alert on dcgm_ecc_windowed_rate > 0.015 for 10m.
Liam: Also propose exporter relabel to reduce per-card scrape to 30s -> 60s for cards with transient spikes. Example relabel_config in node-exporter or dcgm-exporter: `ifcard_label=card_id; ifcard_label_matches: <list>; action: replace; target_scrape_interval: 60s` (pseudo).
Jordan: We can implement a short-term adaptive backoff in Prometheus alertmanager webhook: on repeated flaps from same card, increase suppression window by factor 2 until stable.
Rachel: Can we test this in us-west-2-canary? Also need runbook changes: do NOT drain unless (streak > 3 spikes AND PCIe errors > 0 AND device_temp > 85C) OR manual triage.
Maya: I'll schedule a canary experiment: deploy recording rule + relabel change + alertmanager backoff for 48h. ops-bot will run the job.
ops-bot: Deploy started: canary/dcgm-diff-sampling experiment -> us-west-2-canary at 2024-11-06T03:40Z
dcgm-bot: Observability note — current flaps correlated with driver package rollout (kernel+cuda) on ~8 nodes (shortly before 02:10 UTC).
Liam: Monitoring plan: 1) compare alert rate pre/post 2) check false-positive ratio vs manual triage 3) review any missed real failures (correlate with RMA logs).
Jordan: If this stabilizes, we push a templated relabel and recording-rule across regions with region-specific sample buckets.
Rachel: I'll update the on-call runbook with new threshold matrix and add the "do not auto-drain" clause.
Maya: Thanks — I'll post summary and link to the canary dashboard once live. :thumbsup:
